title: showcase tool - Acme CRM dispatcher (reference app)
content: The `showcase` tool talks to the tenant's connected Acme CRM (a fictional provider used by the Sprigr app-kit reference app). One dispatcher tool: pass `action` plus that action's arguments. Actions: `list_contacts` (faceted, optionally by `stage`/`owner`), `get_contact` (by `contact_id`), `search_cached_contacts` (`query`, optional `stage`, over the per-company data index), `cache_contact` (`contact_id` + fields, upserts into the data index), `connection_status`. If a call reports 'No Acme account linked', open the app settings page and click Connect Acme; check with `{"action":"connection_status"}` first when unsure.
keywords: showcase, acme, crm, dispatcher, contacts, deals, connection_status, list_contacts, get_contact, search_cached_contacts, cache_contact, data index, reference app, every feature

title: cache_contact + search_cached_contacts - the per-company data index
content: The showcase app caches Acme contacts into its per-company data index (searchable by name/email/company; faceted by stage/owner/source per the manifest data_index config). Write one with `{"action":"cache_contact","contact_id":"c_1","name":"...","stage":"won","owner":"alex"}`. Read them back with `{"action":"search_cached_contacts","query":"acme","stage":"won"}` - returns hits plus facet counts for stage/owner/source. Caching also fires the `showcase.contact.cached` marketplace event. These paths call env.SPRIGR.data.* and only run on the platform, not the local `sprigr app dev` harness.
keywords: cache_contact, search_cached_contacts, data index, faceted search, facets, stage, owner, source, semantic search, env.SPRIGR.data, per-company index, upsert, objectID
